label: Gatterer's new Universalhistorie Plan is embodied in lecture and textbook architecture
subject: agent.johann-christoph-gatterer

sources.citation: André de Melo Araújo, Weltgeschichte in Göttingen (Bielefeld: transcript, 2012), pp. 73-74
Johann Christoph Gatterer, Antwort auf die Schlözersche Species Facti (Göttingen: Dieterich, 1773), p. 12
Johann Christoph Gatterer, Handbuch der Universalhistorie (1761), a4r and p. 60

observations.value: Gatterer retrospectively says that in his first Göttingen year he read the Hauptsachen from his own Entwurf and used Cellarius so that he would not have to dictate too much.
The Handbuch says it was written first for Gatterer's Göttingen Universalhistorie lectures and undertaken nach einem ganz neuen Plan because no usable textbook existed.
Araújo reconstructs the fourfold Beschäftigung as the organisation through which the new Plan is materially realised in the Handbuch.

claim_limit: This establishes Plan as embodied in lecture/textbook organisation. It does not by itself establish that any specific table, diagram or colour practice was an object of the 1773 plagiarism allegation.

label: Synchronistic tables operate inside Gatterer's Plan as instruments for making historical Zusammenhang clear
subject: work.gatterer-handbuch-universalhistorie.1761
object: Zusammenhang und Verbindung gleichzeitiger Völker und Reiche

sources.citation: Johann Christoph Gatterer, Handbuch der Universalhistorie (1761), pp. 61-62

observations.value: Events of each people/state are narrated chronologically so that Staatsveränderungen can be made intelligible/visible.
Simultaneously flourishing kingdoms and states are to be narrated in einem synchronistischen Zusammenhänge.

Köhler's synchronistic tables are retained to verdeutlichen the Zusammenhang und Verbindung gleichzeitiger Völker und Reiche; Araújo says this relation is, nach Gatterer's Plan, especially indispensable for recent universal-historical facts.

claim_limit: Directly inspect Handbuch pp. 61-62 before treating the exact wording as primary_direct. The source supports integration of table function into Plan implementation, not explicit ownership of tables in the 1773 polemic.

label: Pütter records tables and planiglobes as routine apparatus in Gatterer's Universalhistorie lectures
subject: agent.johann-christoph-gatterer
object: genealogical Ländertafeln, synchronistische Tabellen and Planigloben

sources.citation: Johann Stephan Pütter, Versuch einer academischen Gelehrten-Geschichte von der Georg-Augustus-Universität zu Göttingen, vol. 2 (1788), §239, pp. 343-344

observations.value: Pütter reports genealogische Ländertafeln, synchronistische Tabellen und Planigloben being brought to Gatterer's Universalhistorie lecture.
The stated purpose is zu besserer Uebersicht des Ganzen.

claim_limit: This is a later teaching-practice control and must not be projected backward as proof that the same apparatus was explicitly disputed as intellectual property in 1773.

label: Does the material implementation of Gatterer's Plan become priority-bearing method-property in 1773?
notes: Araújo now establishes a bridge from Gatterer's new Plan to lecture/textbook architecture and from the same Plan to synchronistic tables that clarify historical Zusammenhang; Pütter later documents tables and planiglobes as routine lecture apparatus for Uebersicht des Ganzen. The missing link is whether Gatterer or Schlözer explicitly treats any table, graphical disposition, lecture apparatus or synchronistic implementation as part of the Plan/Denkungsart/Methode/Entdeckungen that could be borrowed or plagiarised.
reopen_rule: Directly inspect Gatterer Antwort pp. 5, 12, 37-38 and Schlözer Species Facti pp. 401-415 for Tabelle/Tafel, Synchronismus, Karte, Planiglobus, Übersicht, Darstellung, Einrichtung, Lehrart, Schema, Entwurf and any deictic reference to specific books/tables. Separately direct-control Gatterer Handbuch pp. 60-62 so the bridge does not rest solely on Araújo's paraphrase.
